about_the_game:
It's up to you to blow up the approaching meteorite and become the savior of the Earth!

◆Prologue◆

In the year 20XX, an asteroid from outside the solar system approaches the Earth.

Humanity responds with a nuclear attack, but the meteorite is not destroyed and splits into 50 pieces.

The only hope left is a single explosion specialist!

◆Game Overview◆

"Earth Saver" is an exhilarating explosion action game in which you blow up and dismantle a giant meteorite approaching the Earth!

Place a bomb and it will explode with a bang in three counts!

If you successfully split the meteorite into small pieces, it will burn up in the atmosphere and the Earth will be safe!

Connect and blow up, split cleanly, the exhilaration is at its maximum!

But if you're not careful, the large pieces will head straight for the Earth...!

This is a highly strategic action game in which the timing and placement of the explosion are key.

The controls are simple.

Just move your character and place the bomb with the button!

Easy to play for anyone, yet deep.

Fun for beginners and blast specialists alike.

Think of a route within a limited time and protect the Earth with your intuition and judgement!

◆ Enjoy as many times as you like with 7 diverse modes! ◆

[Difficulty modes]

● EASY: Practice mode for beginners. No enemies, so you can relax!

● NORMAL: A well-balanced mode for intermediate players.

● HARD: A challenge mode for advanced players with a strict time limit!

● EXPERT: A serious mode with fast enemies and no time carryover!

● ULTIMATE: A super difficult mode where you aim to clear all stages without making any mistakes!

[Featured challenge modes]

● ENDLESS: Infinite stages with no goal! Challenge yourself to see how far you can go. Online rankings are also supported!

● BATTLE: A blasting showdown for two people! A battle mode that you can enjoy with your friends by sharing play!
